A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the multiple scalar particle decays can produce large curvature perturbations and the isocurivirusity perturbation of matter-radiation system.
the isocuravity perturbations of radiation and matter components are not useful to constrain models of multiple scalar fields decaying.
the isocurvatures are not useful to constrain the scalar field models.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the evolution of the scalar fields is not a simple sum of the individual evolutions, and the evolution of the perturbations is not a simple superposition of the perturbation evolutions of each individual field.
the isocurvatures are not necessarily suppressed compared with curvature perturbations in the multiple decaying scalar fields model.
the evolution of the curvature perturbation is determined by the total energy density of the decaying scalar field, not the energy density of the decay products.
